en: How should people and automation share tasks? I study human-in-the-loop decisions, trust and when control should change hands.
I study how to model agents for collaborative tasks and assess how closely their behavior reflects human cognition and action.
When are people more likely to make mistakes in complex systems? I study how context affects performance and how to account for it in risk assessment.
zh: 人和自动化系统如何分配任务？我关注人在环决策、人机信任，以及控制权何时应当切换。
面向协作任务，我关注如何建立智能体模型，以及如何评估它的行为与人的认知和行为是否一致。
复杂系统中的人何时容易出错？我关注情境因素如何影响人的表现，以及如何将这些影响纳入风险评估。
